name: Location Data Analysis
description: Ability to extract and analyse location data from mobile devices. Covers GPS logs, cell tower records, Wi-Fi connection history, significant locations and on-device timeline databases, application-embedded geolocation metadata, and correlating location data with other evidence to establish movement patterns and presence at specific locations.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to mobile location data analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the types of location data stored on mobile devices and their forensic significance
evidence: Can describe location data sources on mobile devices (GPS, cell tower, Wi-Fi, app data)
Understands the difference between precise GPS positioning and cell site location estimation
Can explain privacy considerations and legal requirements for location evidence

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Extracts and maps location data from mobile device acquisitions under supervision
evidence: Extracted iOS Significant Locations and Android on-device Timeline data, or Takeout exports where available, under guidance
Parsed GPS coordinates from photo EXIF metadata on mobile devices
Plotted location data on maps using forensic tools to visualise movement patterns
Documented location data findings with supervisor review and proper coordinate notation

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently analyses location data from multiple sources to establish movement patterns and produces court-ready location reports
evidence: Independently analysed location evidence in 5+ investigations
Correlated cell tower records with GPS data and Wi-Fi history to confirm location patterns
Produced location timeline reports with maps suitable for court presentation
Correctly accounted for location data accuracy limitations in reports and testimony

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex location analysis including multi-device correlation, cell site analysis, and challenging accuracy assessments
evidence: Performed cell site analysis using tower location data and propagation modelling
Correlated location data across multiple devices and evidence sources
Assessed and communicated location data accuracy and reliability for contentious cases
Mentors junior examiners on location data interpretation and reporting

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines location analysis methodology; provides expert testimony on location evidence reliability; researches new location artifacts
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's mobile location data analysis methodology
Provided expert testimony on location evidence interpretation and accuracy
Published research on mobile location artifacts or analysis techniques
Trains teams on location data analysis and cell site interpretation

assessment_methods.description: Extract location data from a mobile device acquisition, correlate with cell tower records, and produce a movement timeline with mapped visualisation
Given conflicting location data from multiple sources, assess reliability and determine the most probable location timeline
